'''Frod Makora''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|3.0}}</ref> shortly before the [[Battle of Rishi]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jakarro]] hired Makora to lend his [[Unidentified speeder van model|speeder van]] to Jakarro's allies in order to reach [[Tracyn Island]]. Unfortunately for Makora, the group was shot down on the approach and his vehicle was wrecked.<ref name="Blood" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frod Makora appear as the starter character for "Blood Hunt," a Flashpoint added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''.<ref name="Blood" />
